What the Role Entails
About WorkSolo
WorkSolo is a professional creation tool built for AI creators. It empowers independent creators, studios, and creative professionals with AI-native workflows to ideate, produce, and publish high-quality content — from concept to final output. As we expand globally, we're looking for a creative and technically fluent AI Script Editor to help define what great AI-generated storytelling looks like for international audiences.Key Responsibilities:
AI Content Evaluation & Process Design
- Lead the evaluation of AI-generated content quality, establishing clear benchmarks and frameworks for narrative effectiveness, emotional resonance, and audience engagement
- Design and continuously refine end-to-end content generation workflows in close collaboration with Agent engineers
- Develop testing methodologies and feedback loops to systematically improve AI output quality across storylines, dialogue, and scene construction
Skill Development & Iteration
- Own the optimization and iterative improvement of creative-focused AI Skills within the WorkSolo platform
- Translate real-world screenwriting craft into structured, reusable prompt engineering patterns and workflow templates
- Document and share skill learnings to build a scalable creative knowledge base for the team
Content Quality & Localization
- Ensure AI-generated storylines are highly consumable, emotionally compelling, and culturally resonant for overseas audiences
- Apply deep knowledge of international content consumption habits to shape plot structures, pacing, character arcs, and dialogue styles
- Serve as the creative quality bar-raiser — reviewing, editing, and elevating AI-generated scripts to professional production standards

Who We Look For
Qualifications- 1–5 years of screenwriting experience for overseas short dramas, films, or series; at least one produced and released overseas project required
- Substantial hands-on experience with AI co-creation; fluent with mainstream SOTA models (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, Gemini) and their application in creative workflows
- Has developed a personal, distinctive AI-assisted writing workflow with documented skill and prompt libraries
- Native-level English writing ability; capable of producing scripts that read as authentically Western in voice, tone, and cultural reference
- Solid understanding of overseas content ecosystems — including streaming platforms (Netflix, Hulu, YouTube), short-form drama platforms (Webtoon, Wattpad, Radish), and social video trends (TikTok, Instagram Reels)
- Bonus: Experience with short-form vertical drama formats, interactive storytelling, or AI-generated visual narrative content
- Comfortable working at the intersection of creative craft and technical systems; ability to communicate effectively with both engineering and product teams

US-California-Los Angeles
